newsitem.title: USA: US CREDIT OUTLOOK - Payrolls take centre stage.
newsitem.headline: US CREDIT OUTLOOK - Payrolls take centre stage.

text.p: A growing perception that the Federal Reserve's policy-making arm would hold off further tightening at its meeting in July pushed yields lower on Friday.
The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported May nonfarm payrolls rose 138,000, far less than economists' expectations of a rise of more than 200,000 -- even given seasanal revisions.

The data continued to paint a picture of contained inflationary pressure for the U.S. economy, making it politically difficult for the Federal Reserve to justify further tightening of monetary policy.
